div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Sistema de agendamento · 17 ciclos de vida

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Ciclo da encomenda
pending → paid → confirmed → serving
→ completed → reviewed
pending/paid → cancelled
paid → refunding → refunded
técnico bloqueado 3 min · reembolso gerente→financeiro 2 níveis

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Compra em grupo
ongoing → joined → group_paid
ongoing → full → closed
joined → cancelled (não formado)
Redis NX anti-sobrevenda · preço = original × discount_percent

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Venda relâmpago
published → ongoing → sold_out / ended
ongoing → seckill_order
bloqueio de linha stock-1 · cancelar não repõe stock

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Desconto direto
draft → published → used / ended
pós-cupão ≥ threshold desconto automático, maior valor · grupo/relâmpago saltam

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Callback de pagamento
registo → encomenda unificada → frontend invoca
→ verificação WeChat → estado paid → notificar ambos

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Cartão de membro
active → used_up (sessões esgotadas)
active → expired (mensal/VIP expira)
active ⇄ frozen (congelar/descongelar)

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Cupão
draft → published → claimed
claimed → used / expired
published → ended (stock esgotado/expirou)

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Oferta de cupão
available → transferred (código 8, válido 7 dias)
→ claimed / expired (avaliação tardia restaura)
Redis NX + linha anti-duplicação · só 1 oferta por cupão

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Expiração de pontos
earned (expires_at = now + 365 dias)
→ used / expired
PointsExpiryTimer a cada 60s · idempotência 3 camadas

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Transferência de saldo/pontos
validating → locked → completed / failed
client_token repetido → idempotent
Redis NX 30s + linha ambos os lados (user_id ascendente)

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Fatura eletrónica
pending → issued (invoice_no + issued_at)
pending → rejected (reject_reason)
uk_order_type evita duplicados, valor do servidor

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Adesão de técnico
applied → approved → active
applied → rejected → applied (reenvio)
active ⇄ suspended · active → banned

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Autenticação Token
issued → active → refreshed → active
active → blacklisted (logout/password/concorrência > 3)
active → expired (7 dias sem uso)

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Eliminação de conta
active → requested (saldo/encomendas/tickets 422)
requested → active (cancelar pedido)
requested → closing (confirmado após 72h)
anonimiza phone/nickname + status=0

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Levantamento do técnico
pending → approved → processing → completed (T+1 saldo WeChat)
pending → rejected → devolvido
gerente revê → financeiro confirma, 2 níveis

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Ticket de apoio
open ⇄ open (resposta do painel acrescenta)
open → closed (só o próprio/só open, rating 1-5 opcional)

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Roda da sorte
on → spun → points / balance / coupon / lose
Redis NX + linha + pesos random_int + idempotência client_token

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Recompensa de cliente recorrente
completed → checked → pending → settled / none
mesmo técnico em 30 dias · idempotente por order_id+type
